 ## What's new
 
+### AI Permit Assistant (Generally Available)
+
+AI Permit Assistant automatically detects the permit requirements for a job's
+jurisdiction and pre-fills the permit application directly from the job record,
+so office staff no longer rekey permit data. Available to all Trade customers
+starting this release. Part of the Titan Intelligence suite.
+
 ### Scheduling improvements
 
 Minor fixes to the dispatch board drag-and-drop.
